unknownBehavior: The product owner has not chosen the milestone, duration, or scope of the external stable-document compatibility/support commitment.
architectureImpact: None: grape.document 1.0 identity, schema version policy, safe forward recovery, exact module pins, and ACK-backed save/reopen are technically defined in IH-003. This is a public support promise, not a choice of document owner or format.
blocks: An external stable document compatibility guarantee or initial release statement claiming such a guarantee before owner decision.
doesNotBlock: Internal S01 implementation once separately authorized.
Internal document codec fixtures and architecture qualification.
Slices independent of an external compatibility promise.
earliestRequiredPhase: Before the first release or external statement that promises stable long-term document compatibility; earlier if migration acceptance expressly depends on that promise.
requiredEvidence: An explicit product-owner decision naming commitment start milestone and intended support duration/scope.
At that milestone, retain the promised format fixtures and qualify all needed conversion paths before any incompatible release.
disproofAction: If an earlier milestone is chosen, expand the retained compatibility corpus and qualify explicit migrations. A later milestone still does not authorize same-version schema reinterpretation or destructive loading. No default owner choice is inferred.
sourceRefs: Independent review: B2 / human decision 2 / recommended S01 boundary
